name: @kokoro.ws/mcp

tools.name: fetch-integrations
tools.description: Fetches all the integrations and accounts the user has connected with Kokoro, and operations are supported. Also displays all the calendars and tasklists the user has connected with Kokoro.

tools.name: fetch-calendar
tools.description: Fetches the specified calendar. Will return complete details about the calendar, permissions, limitations, etc. YOU MUST FETCH DETAILS OF A CALENDAR BEFORE REALIZING USING IT.

tools.name: fetch-tasklist
tools.description: Fetches the specified tasklist. Will return complete details about the tasklist, permissions, limitations, etc. YOU MUST FETCH DETAILS OF A TASKLIST BEFORE REALIZING USING IT.

tools.name: query-memories
tools.description: Memories are Kokoro's way of storing information from different sources in a single place.

contentQuery.description: A query to search for memories by content

descriptionQuery.description: A query to search for memories by description

startDate.description: A start date to filter memories by. Must be in ISO 8601 format.

endDate.description: An end date to filter memories by. Must be in ISO 8601 format.

integrationAccountIds.description: If provided, only memories from these integration accounts will be returned. If not provided, won't be filtered by integration accounts.

calendarIds.description: If provided, only memories from these calendars will be returned. If not provided, won't be filtered by calendars.

tasklistIds.description: If provided, only memories from these tasklists will be returned. If not provided, won't be filtered by tasklists.

sortBy.description: The sort order of the memories

tools.name: fetch-memory
tools.description: Fetches the specified memory. Will return complete details about the memory, permissions, limitations, etc.

tools.name: query-contacts
tools.description: Contacts are Kokoro's way of storing information about people. If you need information about a person, you can use this tool to search for them.

email.description: An email to search for contacts by

name.description: A name to search for contacts by. Full text search will be performed.

tools.name: calendar-create-event
tools.description: Creates an event on the specified calendar.

integrationAccountsTable.description: The id of the integration account

summary.description: The summary of the calendar event.

startDate.description: The start date of the calendar event. Must be in ISO 8601 format.

endDate.description: The end date of the calendar event. Must be in ISO 8601 format.

isFullDay.description: Whether the event is a full day event.

recurrence.description: Only if the event has recurrence, the recurrence of the calendar event. Must follow RRULE format. Do not include DTSTART, DTEND, or EXDATE.

tools.name: calendar-modify-event
tools.description: Modifies an event. If the event is recurring, you must specify a recurrence modifier. If the memory event is virtual, and when only virtual, provide the virtual start date.

integrationAccountsTable.description: The id of the integration account

memoryId.description: The id of the memory containing the event.

virtualStartDate.description: <nullable> IF VIRTUAL ONLY, provide the start date of the virtual event.

summary.description: The summary of the calendar event.

startDate.description: The start date of the calendar event. Must be in ISO 8601 format.

endDate.description: The end date of the calendar event. Must be in ISO 8601 format.

isFullDay.description: Whether the event is a full day event.

recurrence.description: The recurrence of the calendar event. Must follow RRULE format. Do not include DTSTART, DTEND, or EXDATE.

recurrenceType.description: ONLY IF THE EVENT YOU'RE MODIFYING HAS RECURRENCE, you must provide how the update should be made. ALL will update every instance. THIS_AND_FOLLOWING will update this instance and the following ones. INSTANCE will only update the instance you're modifying.

tools.name: calendar-delete-event
tools.description: Deletes an event on the specified calendar. If the event is recurring, you must specify a recurrence modifier. If the memory event is virtual, and when only virtual, provide the virtual start date.

integrationAccountsTable.description: The id of the integration account

memoryId.description: The id of the memory containing the event.

virtualStartDate.description: <nullable> IF VIRTUAL ONLY, provide the start date of the virtual event.

recurrenceAction.description: ONLY IF THE EVENT YOU'RE MODIFYING HAS RECURRENCE, you must provide how the update should be made. ALL will update every instance. THIS_AND_FOLLOWING will update this instance and the following ones. INSTANCE will only update the instance you're modifying.

tools.name: calendar-change-event-attendance
tools.description: Changes the attendance of an event on the specified calendar.

integrationAccountsTable.description: The id of the integration account

memoryId.description: The id of the memory containing the event.

virtualStartDate.description: <nullable> IF VIRTUAL ONLY, provide the start date of the virtual event.

state.description: The state of the attendance change.

comment.description: The comment to add to the attendance change.

tools.name: tasks-create-task
tools.description: Creates a task on the specified tasklist.

integrationAccountsTable.description: The id of the integration account

description.description: The description of the task. Can use markdown.

dueDate.description: The due date of the task. Must be in ISO 8601 format.

tools.name: tasks-modify-task
tools.description: Modifies a task on the specified tasklist.

integrationAccountsTable.description: The id of the integration account

description.description: The description of the task. Can use markdown.

dueDate.description: The due date of the task. Must be in ISO 8601 format.

tools.name: tasks-delete-task
tools.description: Deletes a task on the specified tasklist.

integrationAccountsTable.description: The id of the integration account
